name: student-q4-v4-shortedit-final
hypothesis: PAIRED with student-q4-v3-final: identical config, tools and 48 dev tasks (temperature 0, one run each); only the adapter differs: trained on sft_train_v3.jsonl (teacher old_string shortened to the shortest unique snippet, 55% of the characters), same hyper-parameters, final step (456). Prediction fixed before running: edit_file calls whose old_string is not found in earlier output (76/94 in the baseline) go down, and passes exceed 4/48. Primary result is the final adapter; no checkpoint selection. Caveat: one extra validation example (8 vs 7), so val losses are not comparable.
